verdict.rationale: The only versioning signal is a documentation path at help.getzep.com/v3/llms.txt, which implies a v3 API or docs generation. Nothing in the pack describes an explicit API versioning scheme, deprecation timelines, sunset notices or a changelog policy. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning documentation, a documented deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or migration guides between Zep API versions, and independent corroboration of version stability.
